author: Bobby Grayson
description:
When parallelism was added, mmap performance suffered significantly. Lock-free data structures and per-worker buffers became necessary.

Sources:
- c809679: 'Memory maps appear to degrade quite a bit in the presence of multithreading. Also, switch to lock free data structures for synchronization. Give each worker an input and output buffer which require no synchronization.'
title: Memory maps degrade with multithreading
